name: 1-on-1 Meeting
description: Manager/employee one-on-one meeting template focused on check-in, discussion topics, and action items.

sections.title: Check-in
sections.instruction: Summarize the overall tone of the meeting, how the employee is doing, and any personal or professional updates shared.

sections.title: Discussion Topics
sections.instruction: List the main topics discussed during the meeting, including project updates, blockers, and feedback exchanged.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: List all assigned tasks with their owners and due date. Always add reference transcript segment and timestamp in the table.
sections.item_format:
| **Owner** | Task | Due | Reference Transcript Segment | Segment Time stamp |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

sections.title: Follow-up Notes
sections.instruction: Capture any follow-up items, agreed-upon next steps, or topics to revisit in the next 1-on-1.
